description:
Advances: ancora.derive

Found while orchestrating ancora-gg8 (2026-09-03). None of the eight subject specs under .spec/specs/ declare surface: in spec-meta. After ancora-gg8.5 lands the primary/transitive drift split, subjects without a surface list treat all drift as primary, so ancora own corpus keeps the fan-out gg8.5 is meant to remove: two wave-1 tickets (gg8.2, gg8.4) hit derived/drift on subjects that merely reach a changed function.

Deliverable: for each subject spec, add a surface: list naming the lib files that subject owns (the files whose functions its contract describes). Verify with mix spec.validate, and with mix spec.check --base <trunk> on a small perf-style refactor fixture showing drift on non-surface subjects lands as derived/drift_transitive at info.

Sequence after ancora-gg8.5 merges. Filed standalone, not as a child of ancora-gg8, so the epic does not grow silently.
title: Author surface: lists on ancora's own subject specs so the drift split applies to this repo
